summary: Student-run online hackathon on AI and healthcare, with cash prizes, sponsor credits and a research-oriented award run with YRI.
eligibility: Students aged 13+; companies and professional organisations cannot enter; open to all countries with standard exceptions in the rules.
title: DSH Hacks V2

prize.description: US$42,234 pool incl. credits: top three cash US$3,928 / US$3,543 / US$3,363, 100 x US$299 Tin Computer credits, and US$1,500 plus scholarship for best research project.

notes: Most of the headline pool is credits; cash is the three top prizes plus the research award.
